about.text: Kaimaghi is a thick cream of about 60% milk fat, similar to clotted cream, eaten at breakfast or as a dessert in the Caucasus. Raw milk is simmered slowly for about two hours on very low heat, then the cream is skimmed and chilled for several hours or days while it mildly ferments.
